About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

We're adding a Clinical Trial Manager to take ownership of study delivery as our clinical portfolio grows. You'll be responsible for turning clinical development plans into well-run trials, keeping sites, CROs and internal teams focused on what matters: enrolling patients, protecting their safety and generating reliable data.

Based in Copenhagen, you'll work closely with Clinical Operations colleagues and teams across both locations. This is a hands-on role with room to shape how we run studies as Hemab grows.

What you'll do

• Take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of assigned clinical trials, from start-up through close-out, against agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.

• Drive site activation and patient recruitment, working with investigators and CROs to identify obstacles early and find practical solutions.

• Manage CROs and external vendors, holding partners accountable for their commitments and addressing performance issues directly.

• Develop and maintain study plans, timelines and risk assessments that give the team a clear picture of progress and what needs attention.

• Work closely with Clinical Development, Medical, Regulatory, Data Management and Quality colleagues to resolve study issues and keep decisions moving.

• Oversee study budgets, forecasts and vendor expenditure, identifying potential overruns before they become problems.

• Maintain compliance with ICH-GCP, study protocols and applicable regulations, with inspection readiness built into everyday trial delivery.

• Help establish practical ways of working that can be used across studies without adding unnecessary complexity.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Experience managing interventional clinical trials, with direct responsibility for study delivery and oversight of external partners.

• A working knowledge of clinical trial start-up, site management, recruitment, monitoring and close-out.

• Experience addressing recruitment delays, site performance issues or other challenges that threaten study timelines.

• Sound knowledge of ICH-GCP and the regulatory requirements governing clinical trials.

• Experience managing CROs, study budgets and timelines, with the judgement to know when to escalate an issue.

• The ability to work effectively with colleagues across clinical, scientific and regulatory disciplines, including when priorities change.

Nice to have

• Experience in rare diseases, haematology or coagulation.

• Experience working in a smaller biotech company or helping establish clinical trial ways of working.

• Experience with international, multicentre clinical studies.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

We value people who take responsibility when something goes wrong, ask for help when needed and work without ego. At our size, how you work matters as much as where you've worked. Good structure should help people move faster and trust each other, not create more work.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)

Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

The Role

As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.

• Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.

• Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.

• Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.

• Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.

• Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

Your Potential Background

We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.

You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

Required Skills

• Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.

• Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.

• Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

• Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.

• Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.

• Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.

• Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

**Who is Understory?

**Understory is a vertical-focused software platform built for experience businesses – from kayaking tours to cooking classes. Our operating system helps creators manage operations, grow bookings, accept payments, and run their business with clarity and less stress.

We move fast, iterate quickly, and expect everyone to bring proactive solutions every day. You'll learn faster here than almost anywhere else because the challenges are real and the pace is high. This isn't about clocking in and out - the right candidate will get a lot of trust and ownership, and it's all about building something that matters to creators around the world.

We recently raised a €12M Series A and are scaling fast. With customers in 10+ countries and a growing presence in Europe, our focus is global, our ambition is high, and our team is fully committed to becoming the go-to platform for experience creators worldwide.

**About The Role

**As our Nordic SDR, you'll own outbound in our Nordic markets - generating qualified leads and building relationships with potential customers for our Account Executives. You'll bring energy, structure, and a high standard to your outreach, and you'll contribute directly to revenue growth while sharing valuable insights on local market dynamics.

You'll research and connect with experience providers – from tours and classes to events and local activities – and turn conversations into booked meetings. You'll also help sharpen our playbooks and raise the bar for how we approach outbound.

**What You'll Do

**

• Identify and research potential customers (experience providers, venues, activity operators) in Denmark and Sweden.

• Execute a high-volume outbound strategy across calls, email, and LinkedIn.

• Qualify leads and schedule meetings for Account Executives.

• Maintain accurate lead and prospect data in CRM; track progress and report insights.

• Share learnings about the Nordic markets - local trends, competitor activity, and cultural preferences.

• Collaborate with marketing and product teams to refine messaging and support growth.

**What Success Looks Like

**Months 1–2 - Ramp & Launch: Complete onboarding; start booking initial meetings; hit full productivity by week 8.

Month 3+ - Consistent Flow: 40+ demos per month derived from outbound outreach.

Ongoing - Revenue Generation: Generate a pipeline that converts to closed revenue (quality over quantity).

**What We're Looking For

**

• You need to be native in one of our Nordic markets: native level of Danish, Swedish or Norwegian, plus fluency in English (written and spoken).

• Strong communication and outreach skills; proactive and well-organised.

• High coachability and resilience; you view feedback as a growth tool and "no" as just a step toward your next "yes".

• Deep business curiosity; you love understanding how companies work and tailoring your approach to solve their unique problems.

• Cultural sensitivity and ability to adapt pitches to the Danish, Swedish or Norwegian markets.

• Passion for experiences, travel, and the experience economy.

• Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment.

• Someone living in either Copenhagen or Barcelona to join one of our offices.

**Nice To Have

**

• Network within the tourism, travel, or events industries in Denmark or Sweden.

• Familiarity with experience-booking platforms, hospitality, or SaaS.

• Experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Gong.

**Why You'll Thrive at Understory

**

• Join a small, ambitious team where your insights directly impact pipeline growth.

• Work in a collaborative environment with autonomy, trust, and flexibility.

• Learn fast and grow fast - the challenges are real, and the pace is high.

• Be part of a mission-driven company redefining the experience industry worldwide.

**Start Date & Application

**We review applications on a rolling basis and will hire as soon as we find the right person.

Start date: We're always on the lookout for great candidates, so don't hesitate to apply.

If you have any questions about the role or the process, feel free to reach out to Hugo at hugo@understory.io.

Join the Electro-Acoustics team

• Acoustic or vibro-acoustic simulation (e.g. lumped-element models, FEM/BEM – ANSYS or similar)

• Knowledge of electro-acoustic standards (e.g. IEC 60118 / ANSI S3.22), test systems and calibration

• Experience with Python and/or MATLAB for measurement automation, data analysis and tool development

• Experience with signal processing, electronics or system integration

• Hands-on experience with agile/SAFe ways of working and the mindset to drive and inspire a team within it

Who you are

As a person, you are proud of your profession, curious and a team player at heart. You see the whole system and enjoy connecting the dots across disciplines. We are looking for a Senior Patent Attorney to play a central role in protecting and enabling innovation across Demant's global business and help shape the future of our Intellectual Property function.

In this role, you will partner closely with R&D teams, engineers, scientists, and business stakeholders to ensure that Demant continues to develop and launch innovative products with the lowest possible litigation risk. You will contribute to the growth and strengthening of our international patent portfolio while providing strategic IP guidance that supports our business ambitions.

This role requires more than technical expertise and patent law knowledge. It requires curiosity, commercial understanding, good stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex technologies into valuable intellectual property. This is where you come in.

Welcome to Demant Intellectual Property

You will join Demant's Intellectual Property team at our Demant headquarters in Smørum, just outside Copenhagen, and become part of a highly skilled and collaborative team consisting of Patent Attorneys, Trademark Attorneys, and IP Paralegals.

Demant is a growing, world-leading hearing healthcare corporation that offers solutions in hearing devices, diagnostic instruments, and intelligent audio and video equipment. Through innovative technologies and deep expertise, we are dedicated to making life-changing differences for people with hearing loss around the world.

Our team consists of 14 colleagues from several different nationalities and professional backgrounds. We believe that results are achieved through collaboration and knowledge-sharing. We actively support one another, provide constructive feedback, and continuously develop our collective expertise in both technology and intellectual property.

Working closely with globally distributed business units and R&D organizations, our primary purpose is to help ensure that Demant's products can successfully reach the market while minimizing intellectual property risks.

Help protect the innovations of tomorrow

Joining us, you will bring an intellectual property perspective to strategic technology decisions and help researchers, engineers, and business leaders navigate an increasingly complex innovation landscape.

A key part of your role will be identifying opportunities and risks early in the development process and helping stakeholders answer critical questions: Are we free to commercialize this technology? How can we strengthen our competitive position? How can we protect our innovations globally? And how do we build an IP portfolio that supports Demant's long-term business strategy?

You will work across the boundaries of technology, law, and business, helping transform ideas into protected innovations while supporting product and technology development from concept to market launch.

In this role, you will

• Support innovation throughout the product lifecycle – Participate in R&D project groups and provide IP guidance throughout the development process and help teams make informed technology and business decisions.

• Drive freedom-to-operate activities – Conduct analyses and provide strategic advice to ensure products can be launched with the lowest possible litigation risk.

• Expand and strengthen Demant's patent portfolio – Evaluate invention disclosures, identify patentable innovations, and actively contribute to the growth of our international patent portfolio.

• Manage patent drafting and prosecution – Prepare, file, and prosecute patent applications in multiple jurisdictions while working closely with inventors and external partners.

• Analyze competitor patents – Prepare, file, and present at opposition proceedings before the European Patent Office

• Develop intellectual property expertise – Contribute to the team's collective knowledge within technology and patent law while continuously expanding your own professional capabilities.

By joining Demant, you will step into a highly visible role where your ability to connect technology, intellectual property, and business strategy will directly support innovation and help protect products that improve the lives of people across the world.

What You Bring

You have a scientific or technical background combined with practical intellectual property experience and a genuine interest in understanding how innovation creates business value.

You bring:

• Qualification as a European Patent Attorney or as a US Patent Attorney.

• 5+ years of experience within intellectual property, gained either in industry, private practice, or a combination of both.

• A scientific or technical degree, preferably within physics, electronics, or a related field.

• Excellent analytical capabilities and the ability to quickly understand new technologies and technical concepts.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex IP matters clearly to a broad range of stakeholders.

• A structured and systematic approach combined with strong attention to detail.

• An interest in understanding business needs and translating them into effective IP strategies.

Finally, you are curious, collaborative, and enjoy working closely with experts across different disciplines. You combine technical depth with commercial awareness, build trusted relationships with stakeholders, and are motivated by helping innovation succeed.

Flexible Working Conditions

At Demant, we work in a collaborative environment built on trust, openness, and strong professional relationships. Networking and knowledge-sharing are essential parts of how we work.

We offer you flexible working conditions, excellent opportunities for professional development, and a highly skilled team that works towards a common goal. From the moment you enter our premises, you will experience Demant's energizing and welcoming spirit.

Join our diverse organization and work alongside colleagues from many different nationalities and backgrounds while contributing to technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

Come and join us

Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than December 13, 2026.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system.

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Director of Patents & Designs, Daniel Fischer, via email at dajf@demant.com.

Help build how AI is done right in a medical device company

Imagine joining a team at the very beginning. Not to maintain something others designed, but to shape what it becomes: the code, the platform, the way of working and the people around you. That is the opportunity in our Quality AI Enabler team.

We are a small team working where AI, cloud technology, software engineering, data and Quality meet. Together with our AI Business Analyst and Quality Engineering Graduate, you will turn promising AI ideas and prototypes into secure, maintainable solutions that help our Quality colleagues work smarter, and ultimately support the quality of the hearing aids that improve people's lives every day. You will be the team's engineering anchor, and with that comes real influence on what we build and how we build it.

Your days will be hands-on. You will design, build and deploy AI-assisted workflows and applications in Microsoft Azure, using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, and enterprise data. You will write backend services, APIs and integrations, and you know what it takes to move a prototype into production. You do not need a manager title to lead: you lead by example, explain technical choices in plain language, and challenge assumptions when something looks fragile.

Experience from a regulated industry is an advantage, but curiosity matters more. Few places let you build this knowledge from the ground up. We are one such place.
